newsitem.title: CHINA: Regal unit's HK$4.6 bln loan detailed.
newsitem.headline: Regal unit's HK$4.6 bln loan detailed.

text.p: A HK$4.6 billion term loan facility for Hong Kong's Regal Hotels International Holdings Ltd is expected to launch soon, one of the arrangers said.
The facility will be launched through a special-purpose company, Key Winner Investment Ltd, and backed by Regal Hotels International.
The loan is mainly denominated in Hong Kong dollars but part of it is available in U.S. dollars at lenders' option.
The seven-year loan has a put option in year five. It pays a margin of 125 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate or 120 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
An underwriting group is being formed.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia, Heng Seng Finance and China Development Finance Co (Hong Kong) are arrangers for the deal.
